verdict.rationale: Typesense documents built-in retrieval-augmented generation and LLM-backed natural language search over indexed data (typesense-docs-42, typesense-docs-41), with a conversational search demo (typesense-docs-62). This gives AI-generated answers grounded in your data, but they are delivered through the search API to end users, not as insights or suggestions inside the product. The Cloud MCP server lets an external agent read metrics and tune search (typesense-docs-43), which is outside the product rather than built-in insight generation. Missing for 10: in-product (dashboard) AI insights or suggestions about your data, detailed docs on how RAG answers are generated and surfaced, independent or hands-on corroboration.
